topic: {澪|みお}'s solo at the year-end concert
title_jp: {澪|みお}のソロと{演奏会|えんそうかい}
context: Sunday 27 December: the {鷹ノ原高校|たかのはらこうこう} brass band gives its free year-end concert at the {公民館|こうみんかん}. Before it starts, {澪|みお} tells アルちゃん she passed the exchange interview and asks him to film her solo, while {颯太|そうた} begs to try the trumpet.
scene: Sunday, the school brass band's year-end concert at the {公民館|こうみんかん}. {澪|みお} runs over before it starts, with big news and a favour to ask.

phrases.jp: ちょっと{手伝って|てつだって|to help|4}もらえない？
phrases.en: Could you give me a hand?
phrases.note: 〜てもらえない？ is softer than 〜て！. With friends and family.

phrases.jp: {動画|どうが|video|4}を{撮って|とって|to film, take (a photo)|4}いただけますか。
phrases.en: Could you film it for me, please?
phrases.note: 〜ていただけますか: the polite request for strangers, staff, teachers.

phrases.jp: {練習|れんしゅう|practice|4}するたびに、{上手|じょうず}になるね。
phrases.en: Every time you practise, you get better.

phrases.jp: {一回|いっかい}だけ、やらせて！
phrases.en: Let me have a go, just once!
phrases.note: Causative 〜させて = let me. Kids say it a lot.

phrases.jp: よかったら、{前|まえ}の{席|せき|seat|4}、{取って|とって}おいてくれる？
phrases.en: If you can, would you save me a seat at the front?
phrases.note: {席|せき}を{取|と}っておく = save a seat in advance.

dialogue_setting: The {公民館|こうみんかん} hall, Sunday afternoon, ten minutes before the concert. You came with {颯太|そうた}.

dialogue.speaker: 澪
dialogue.jp: アルちゃん、{来て|きて}くれてありがとう！{聞いて|きいて}、{留学|りゅうがく|studying abroad|3}の{面接|めんせつ|interview|3}、{通った|とおった|to pass (a test)|4}の！
dialogue.en: アルちゃん, thanks for coming! Listen, I passed the exchange interview!

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: おめでとう！{演奏会|えんそうかい|concert, recital|2}の{前|まえ}に{最高|さいこう|the best|4}のニュースだね。{客席|きゃくせき|audience seats|2}から{応援|おうえん|cheering on, support|4}してるよ。
dialogue.en: Congratulations! Best news ever, right before the concert. I'll be cheering you on from the audience.

dialogue.speaker: 澪
dialogue.jp: ありがとう。でも{本番|ほんばん|the real performance|3}で{吹く|ふく|to blow, play (a wind instrument)|3}たびに、{手|て}が{震える|ふるえる|to shake, tremble|3}んだよね。{ガチで||(slang) seriously, for real|3}。
dialogue.en: Thanks. But every time I play for real, my hands shake. Seriously.
dialogue.note: ガチで is teen slang for {本当|ほんとう}に.

dialogue.speaker: 澪
dialogue.jp: ねえ、ソロのとこ、{動画|どうが|video|4}{撮って|とって|to film|4}もらえない？あとで{見直したい|みなおしたい|to watch again, review|3}から。
dialogue.en: Hey, could you film my solo? I want to watch it back later.
dialogue.note: とこ = ところ (the part). 〜てもらえない？ = a soft casual request.

dialogue.speaker: 颯太
dialogue.jp: ねえねえ、{澪|みお}ちゃん！{終わったら|おわったら}、トランペット{一回|いっかい}{吹かせて|ふかせて|let (me) play it|3}！
dialogue.en: Hey hey, {澪|みお}! When it's over, let me play the trumpet once!

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {颯太|そうた}は{人|ひと}に{会う|あう}たびに{何か|なにか}{頼む|たのむ|to ask for|4}よね。{動画|どうが}は{任せて|まかせて|to leave it to (someone)|4}！
dialogue.en: {颯太|そうた}, every time you meet someone you ask for something. The video, leave it to me!

listening.intro: Just before the concert, {恵子|けいこ}さん leaves a message on your phone.

lines.jp: {恵子|けいこ}です。{演奏会|えんそうかい|concert|2}、{楽しんで|たのしんで}ね。
lines.en: It's {恵子|けいこ}. Enjoy the concert.

lines.jp: {帰り|かえり}に{商店街|しょうてんがい}で、お{餅|もち|rice cake|4}を{二袋|ふたふくろ}{買って|かって}きてくれる？お{願い|ねがい}ね。
lines.en: On the way back, could you buy two bags of rice cakes on the shopping street? Thanks.

listening.question: {恵子|けいこ}さんは{何|なに}を{頼みました|たのみました}か。
options: おもちを二ふくろ買ってくる
えんそうかいの動画をとる
しょうてんがいで待つ
listening.explain: お{餅|もち}を{二袋|ふたふくろ}{買|か}ってきてくれる？ = could you buy two bags of rice cakes and bring them home?

grammar.form: verb: dictionary form + たびに ({吹|ふ}く → {吹|ふ}くたびに, {会|あ}う → {会|あ}うたびに) · noun: + のたびに ({旅行|りょこう}のたびに, {試合|しあい}のたびに)
grammar.explanation: Every time A happens, B happens too: often a feeling, a habit or a change. A bit stronger than 〜とき、いつも. The classic mistake: it never follows the た-form ({会|あ}うたびに, not {会|あ}ったたびに).

examples.jp: この{歌|うた}を{聞く|きく}たびに、スペインを{思い出す|おもいだす}。
examples.en: Every time I hear this song, I think of Spain.

examples.jp: {旅行|りょこう}のたびに、{写真|しゃしん}を{撮り|とり}すぎちゃう。
examples.en: Every time I travel, I take far too many photos.

quiz.question: {颯太|そうた}は{会う|あう}＿＿、サッカーの{話|はなし}をする。
quiz.en: Every time I meet {颯太|そうた}, he talks about football.
quiz.explain: Dictionary form + たびに. ために means 'in order to'.

quiz_more.question: {雪|ゆき}が＿＿、{田中|たなか}さんは5{時|じ}に{起きて|おきて}{雪|ゆき}かきをする。
quiz_more.en: Every time it snows, {田中|たなか}さん gets up at 5 to shovel.
quiz_more.explain: Verbs take the dictionary form: {降|ふ}るたびに. No た-form, no の.

quiz_more.question: {試験|しけん}＿＿、{緊張|きんちょう}してお{腹|なか}が{痛く|いたく}なる。
quiz_more.en: Every exam, I get so nervous my stomach hurts.
quiz_more.explain: After a noun, add の: {試験|しけん}のたびに.

kanji.reading: にゅうじょうむりょう
kanji.where: On the concert poster at the {公民館|こうみんかん} door.
kanji.breakdown: {入場|にゅうじょう}: 入 enter + 場 place → 'entry'; {無料|むりょう}: 無 none + 料 fee → 'free'.
kanji.related: {入場券|にゅうじょうけん} = admission ticket; {有料|ゆうりょう} = there's a charge.

tip.title: Clubs don't stop for winter
tip.body: School clubs ({部活|ぶかつ}) often keep practising into the winter holidays and start again in early January. Brass bands usually give one or two concerts a year, often free, for families and the town.

challenge.prompt: After the concert {颯太|そうた} suddenly goes shy. Ask {澪|みお} for him, casually: could she let him try the trumpet a bit?

options.jp: {颯太|そうた}にも、ちょっと{吹|ふ}かせてもらえない？
options.why: Causative {吹|ふ}かせて (let him play) + もらえない？: a soft, casual request.

options.jp: {颯太|そうた}にも、ちょっと{吹|ふ}いてもらえない？
options.why: No causative: it sounds like you want {颯太|そうた} to play for you, not to be allowed to.

options.jp: {颯太|そうた}にも、ちょっと{吹|ふ}かせていただけませんか。
options.why: Grammatical, but far too stiff for a student you joke with.

options.jp: {颯太|そうた}にも、ちょっと{吹|ふ}かせたい？
options.why: 'Do you want to let him play?' is a question, not a request.

challenge.model_answer: {颯太|そうた}にも、ちょっと{吹かせて|ふかせて|let (him) play|3}もらえない？
challenge.explanation: {吹|ふ}かせる is the causative of {吹|ふ}く: 'let (him) play'. Adding 〜てもらえない？ turns it into a gentle casual request, right for {澪|みお}. With a teacher you'd say 〜ていただけませんか.

vocab.en: to pass (a test); to go through
vocab.note: {面接|めんせつ}に{通|とお}る = pass an interview. {試験|しけん}に{通|とお}る too.
{演奏|えんそう} playing music + {会|かい} gathering. Classical or school bands, not pop.
{応援|おうえん}してるよ = I'm rooting for you. Very common encouragement.
Opposite of {練習|れんしゅう} or rehearsal. {本番|ほんばん}に{強|つよ}い = good under pressure.
From nerves or cold. {手|て}が{震|ふる}える, {声|こえ}が{震|ふる}える.

vocab.en: to look at again; to review
vocab.note: {見|み}る + {直|なお}す fix → look again to check. Also 'see someone in a better light'.
{任|まか}せて！ = leave it to me! Confident and friendly.
{練習|れんしゅう}する = to practise. {朝練|あされん} = morning club practice.

kanji_study.parts: 亻 person radical + 壬 a load hung on a pole → a person carrying the load someone handed them: duty, entrust.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 住 (live): 住 has 主 on the right, 任 has 壬.

kanji_study.parts: 忄 heart radical + 生 be born, life → the heart you are born with: your nature.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 姓 (surname): 姓 has 女 woman on the left, 性 has 忄 heart.

extras.title: Asking for favours, soft to polite
extras.intro: The same favour, from friends to teachers.

items.note: Softer: you'd be receiving a favour.

items.jp: {撮って|とって}いただけますか。

extras.title: At a school concert
extras.intro: Words you'll hear around a brass band.

items.jp: {緊張|きんちょう}したけど、{楽しかった|たのしかった}！
items.en: I was nervous, but it was fun!
